title: Global central banks are pushing CBDCs to defend monetary sovereignty against USD stablecoins, but are struggling to find demand for the digital currencies (Jonathan Levin/Bloomberg)
summary: Jonathan Levin / Bloomberg: Global central banks are pushing CBDCs to defend monetary sovereignty against USD stablecoins, but are struggling to find demand for the digital currencies — Cryptocurrencies emerged in part as a protest against central banks flooding the global economy with money during the financial crisis 18 years ago.
